intro.text_02: Specialist project-based support for finance teams, business owners and companies with complex reporting requirements. Work includes Dutch GAAP-to-IFRS and IFRS-to-Dutch GAAP conversions, consolidation and complex accounting transactions.

deliverables.heading_01: From the question to a defensible answer.
deliverables.text_02: Typical deliverables are agreed as part of the engagement.
deliverables.text_03: Dutch GAAP-to-IFRS and IFRS-to-Dutch GAAP gap assessments, conversion adjustment schedules, opening balances and disclosure support.
deliverables.text_04: Technical accounting memoranda and policy assessments for complex transactions, judgemental matters, revenue, leases and provisions.
deliverables.text_05: Consolidation workpapers, group reporting adjustments, reconciliations and consolidated financial statement preparation.
deliverables.text_06: Acquisition accounting, complex transactions, financial statement preparation and reporting disclosures.

technical_accounting.text_02: A specialist, project-based service for finance teams, business owners and companies with complex reporting requirements. Scope, deliverables and project pricing are agreed by quotation.
technical_accounting.item_01: Dutch GAAP-to-IFRS and IFRS-to-Dutch GAAP conversions
technical_accounting.item_02: Consolidated financial statements and consolidation workpapers
technical_accounting.item_03: Business combinations, acquisition accounting and complex transactions
technical_accounting.item_04: Technical accounting memoranda, accounting policy assessments and financial statement disclosures

contact.heading_01: Facing a reporting or conversion challenge?
contact.text_01: Define the reporting basis, transaction and required outputs. We then agree a realistic timetable and a custom project quote.
